WINDOW_MONITOR.NAME: Window monitor
WINDOW_MONITOR.DESCRIPTION: Combines the contacts of a window into one state: closed, tilted or open

BURGLAR_ALARM.NAME: Burglar alarm
BURGLAR_ALARM.DESCRIPTION: Intrusion alarm from motion, glass, window and door sensors with six time-staggered alarm levels

PRESENCE.DESCRIPTION: Presence / motion sensors (only when armed with presence)

ARM_DELAYED.DESCRIPTION: Pulse: arm after the arming delay, with presence

ARM_DELAYED_NP.DESCRIPTION: Pulse: arm after the arming delay, without presence

OFF.DESCRIPTION: Pulse: disarm; held: locked (cannot be armed)

CONFIRM.DESCRIPTION: Pulse: acknowledge the alarm, the system stays armed

DISABLE_PERIPHERY.DESCRIPTION: 1 = the arming and toggle inputs are ignored (the visualization still works)

REMOTE.DESCRIPTION: Alarm level 6: remote alarm (e.g. caller or monitoring station)

TEST.DESCRIPTION: Alarm in test mode (no alarm levels)

ARMING_REMAINING.DESCRIPTION: Seconds until the system is armed

OPEN_CONTACTS.DESCRIPTION: Number of open windows and doors

OPEN_CONTACTS_TEXT.DESCRIPTION: Announcement of open windows and doors when arming (for text to speech)

SILENT_DELAY.NAME: Silent alarm after [s]
SILENT_DELAY.DESCRIPTION: Seconds after the trigger until alarm level 1

AUDIBLE_DELAY.NAME: Audible alarm after [s]
AUDIBLE_DELAY.DESCRIPTION: Seconds after the trigger until alarm level 2

VISUAL_DELAY.NAME: Visual alarm after [s]
VISUAL_DELAY.DESCRIPTION: Seconds after the trigger until alarm level 3

INTERNAL_DELAY.NAME: Internal alarm after [s]
INTERNAL_DELAY.DESCRIPTION: Seconds after the trigger until alarm level 4

EXTERNAL_DELAY.NAME: External alarm after [s]
EXTERNAL_DELAY.DESCRIPTION: Seconds after the trigger until alarm level 5

REMOTE_DELAY.NAME: Remote alarm after [s]
REMOTE_DELAY.DESCRIPTION: Seconds after the trigger until alarm level 6

MAX_ALARM.NAME: Maximum alarm duration [s]
MAX_ALARM.DESCRIPTION: After this time the alarm levels go off (must be longer than the level delays)

SILENT_CONFIRM.NAME: Acknowledge after maximum duration
SILENT_CONFIRM.DESCRIPTION: The alarm is acknowledged automatically after the maximum alarm duration

PULSE_EXTENSION.NAME: Sensor extension [s]
PULSE_EXTENSION.DESCRIPTION: Short sensor pulses count as active for this time

SECOND_PRESENCE.NAME: Second presence within [s]
SECOND_PRESENCE.DESCRIPTION: A presence sensor only triggers when a second one (or the same one again) reports within this time; 0 = at once

ARM_OPEN_CONTACTS.NAME: Arm with open contacts
ARM_OPEN_CONTACTS.DESCRIPTION: Windows and doors open while arming are ignored until they close

TEST_MODE.NAME: Test mode
TEST_MODE.DESCRIPTION: Sensors only set the test output, no alarm levels

START_DELAY.NAME: Start delay [s]
START_DELAY.DESCRIPTION: After a restart in armed state the sensors are ignored for this time

LIGHTS.NAME: Lights
LIGHTS.DESCRIPTION: Switched on during the visual alarm

TEXT.SEVERAL_OPEN: Attention! Several windows or doors are still open!

BURGLAR_ALARM_CENTRAL.NAME: Burglar alarm central
BURGLAR_ALARM_CENTRAL.DESCRIPTION: Arms, disarms and acknowledges several burglar alarms together

ALARM.DESCRIPTION: One of the burglar alarms has an alarm

ALARMS.NAME: Burglar alarms
ALARMS.DESCRIPTION: The burglar alarm blocks controlled together

FIRE_WATER_ALARM.NAME: Fire and water alarm
FIRE_WATER_ALARM.DESCRIPTION: Fire and water alarm with pre-alarm, main alarm and service mode; always active

TEMPERATURE.DESCRIPTION: Temperature; alarm at the maximum temperature

OFF.DESCRIPTION: Pulse: acknowledge; held: sensors are ignored

PRE_ALARM_SIGNAL.DESCRIPTION: Signal of the pre-alarm (off when silenced)

MAIN_ALARM_SIGNAL.DESCRIPTION: Signal of the main alarm (off when silenced)

MAIN_DELAY.NAME: Main alarm after [s]
MAIN_DELAY.DESCRIPTION: Seconds from the pre-alarm to the main alarm

MAX_TEMPERATURE.NAME: Maximum temperature [°C]
MAX_TEMPERATURE.DESCRIPTION: The temperature input raises an alarm from this value

MAX_ALARM.NAME: Maximum alarm duration [s]
MAX_ALARM.DESCRIPTION: After this time the main alarm goes off; 0 = no limit

PRE_ALARM_CONFIRM.NAME: Acknowledge after maximum duration
PRE_ALARM_CONFIRM.DESCRIPTION: The whole alarm is acknowledged after the maximum duration

SERVICE_MODE.NAME: Service mode
SERVICE_MODE.DESCRIPTION: 0 = off, 1 = permanently on, more = on for that many seconds; sensors only raise a test alarm

SERVICE_DURATION.NAME: Service mode from the visualization [s]
SERVICE_DURATION.DESCRIPTION: Duration of the service mode started in the visualization

LIGHTS.NAME: Lights
LIGHTS.DESCRIPTION: Switched on on a fire alarm

BLINDS.NAME: Blinds
BLINDS.DESCRIPTION: Moved up on a fire alarm (escape routes)

EMERGENCY_ALARM.NAME: Emergency alarm
EMERGENCY_ALARM.DESCRIPTION: Call for help from buttons or the visualization, with acknowledgement and escalation

TOGGLE_HOLD.DESCRIPTION: Push and hold: raises the alarm, or acknowledges it while active

ACTIVATE.DESCRIPTION: Pulse: raise the alarm at once

ALARM_OFF.DESCRIPTION: Pulse when the alarm is acknowledged

CAUSE.DESCRIPTION: Button or user who raised the alarm

CONFIRM_CAUSE.DESCRIPTION: Button or user who acknowledged the alarm

ESCALATED.DESCRIPTION: Nobody acknowledged within the escalation time

HOLD_ALARM.NAME: Hold time alarm [s]
HOLD_ALARM.DESCRIPTION: How long the button must be held to raise the alarm

HOLD_CONFIRM.NAME: Hold time acknowledge [s]
HOLD_CONFIRM.DESCRIPTION: How long the button must be held to acknowledge

ESCALATION.NAME: Escalation after [s]
ESCALATION.DESCRIPTION: Turns on the escalation output when nobody acknowledged; 0 = off

ALARM_CHAIN.NAME: Alarm chain
ALARM_CHAIN.DESCRIPTION: Passes an alarm text from stage to stage until somebody acknowledges, finally to the emergency services

EMERGENCY_IN.DESCRIPTION: 1 = alarm the emergency services at once

TEXT.DESCRIPTION: Text or value for the messages (<vt1>, <v1>)

STAGE_OUT.DESCRIPTION: Alarm text while this stage is active, otherwise empty

REACTION_TIME.NAME: Reaction time [s]
REACTION_TIME.DESCRIPTION: Time per stage; 0 = all stages at once

MAX_REPETITIONS.NAME: Repetitions
MAX_REPETITIONS.DESCRIPTION: Runs through the stages before the emergency services are alarmed; 0 = endless

ALARM_TEXT.NAME: Alarm text
ALARM_TEXT.DESCRIPTION: Placeholders: <vn> name, <vt1-3> texts, <v1-3> values, <v1.2> two decimals, <vton> start, <vcn> customer, <vca> address, <vtes> seconds to emergency services

EMERGENCY_TEXT.NAME: Emergency text
EMERGENCY_TEXT.DESCRIPTION: Text for the emergency services, same placeholders

CALLER.NAME: Caller
CALLER.DESCRIPTION: Calls phone numbers and reads a message with text to speech

VALUE.DESCRIPTION: Value for the message and the numbers (<v1>..<v8>)

RESULT.DESCRIPTION: Result of the last call (number shortened)

NUMBERS.NAME: Phone numbers
NUMBERS.DESCRIPTION: International numbers (+43... or 0043...), separated by commas; placeholders allowed

MESSAGE.NAME: Message
MESSAGE.DESCRIPTION: Spoken text; <vn> name, <v1>..<v8> values, <v1.2> two decimals

LANGUAGE.NAME: Language
LANGUAGE.DESCRIPTION: Language of the text to speech, e.g. de-DE or en-US

TRIGGER_DELAY.NAME: Trigger delay [ms]
TRIGGER_DELAY.DESCRIPTION: Waits after the trigger so the values settle

UPDATE_INTERVAL.NAME: Repeat interval [s]
UPDATE_INTERVAL.DESCRIPTION: Calls again while the trigger stays on; 0 = off

NOTIFY.NAME: Also send a notification
NOTIFY.DESCRIPTION: Sends the message as a server notification too

TWILIO_SID.NAME: Twilio account SID
TWILIO_SID.DESCRIPTION: Account SID (AC...) of the Twilio account

TWILIO_TOKEN.NAME: Twilio auth token
TWILIO_TOKEN.DESCRIPTION: Secret token; visible to everybody who can edit or see this logic

TWILIO_FROM.NAME: Twilio caller number
TWILIO_FROM.DESCRIPTION: Twilio number or verified caller id that calls

SIA.NAME: SIA DC-09
SIA.DESCRIPTION: Sends alarm events to a monitoring station (SIA DC-09 over TCP, optionally AES encrypted)

TRIGGER.DESCRIPTION: Rising edge or change: on message; falling edge: off message (restore)

MESSAGE_IN.DESCRIPTION: Text sent as the whole message, e.g. BA01^Living room

BACKUP_SERVER.NAME: Backup receiver
BACKUP_SERVER.DESCRIPTION: host:port used when the receiver does not answer

POLLING.NAME: Polling [s]
POLLING.DESCRIPTION: Supervision messages to the receiver; 0 = off

BACKUP_POLLING.NAME: Backup polling [s]
BACKUP_POLLING.DESCRIPTION: Supervision messages to the backup receiver; 0 = off

FORMAT.NAME: Data format
FORMAT.DESCRIPTION: 0 = SIA DC-04 (SIA-DCS, text allowed), 1 = Contact ID DC-05 (ADM-CID)

KEY.NAME: Encryption key
KEY.DESCRIPTION: 32, 48 or 64 hex characters (AES-128/192/256); empty = unencrypted. Visible to everybody who can see this logic

ACCOUNT.NAME: Account
ACCOUNT.DESCRIPTION: Account at the monitoring station (3-16 hex characters)

MIN_INTERVAL.NAME: Minimum interval [s]
MIN_INTERVAL.DESCRIPTION: Per input; changes within this time are sent afterwards (latest state)

ON_MESSAGE_1.NAME: I1: on message
ON_MESSAGE_1.DESCRIPTION: Event and zone, e.g. BA01^Living room; <v> = input value

ON_MESSAGE_2.NAME: I2: on message
ON_MESSAGE_2.DESCRIPTION: Event and zone, e.g. BA01^Living room; <v> = input value

ON_MESSAGE_3.NAME: I3: on message
ON_MESSAGE_3.DESCRIPTION: Event and zone, e.g. BA01^Living room; <v> = input value

ON_MESSAGE_4.NAME: I4: on message
ON_MESSAGE_4.DESCRIPTION: Event and zone, e.g. BA01^Living room; <v> = input value

ACCESS_CONTROLLER.NAME: Access controller
ACCESS_CONTROLLER.DESCRIPTION: Users with codes and tags, user groups with access times, door output and access log

TAG.DESCRIPTION: Tag id from an NFC or RFID reader

OPEN.DESCRIPTION: Pulse: open the door (e.g. inside button)

AUTH_MODE.NAME: Authentication
AUTH_MODE.DESCRIPTION: 0 = code and tag, 1 = code or tag, 2 = tag only, 3 = code only

DOOR_ON.NAME: Door open [s]
DOOR_ON.DESCRIPTION: How long the door opener is switched on

MAX_FAILURES.NAME: Failed attempts
MAX_FAILURES.DESCRIPTION: Wrong codes or tags in a row until the lockout; 0 = no lockout

LOCKOUT.NAME: Lockout [s]
LOCKOUT.DESCRIPTION: How long access is locked after too many failed attempts

TWO_FACTOR_WINDOW.NAME: Second factor within [s]
TWO_FACTOR_WINDOW.DESCRIPTION: With code and tag: time for the second factor

CAUSE.FACTORS_MISMATCH: Code and tag belong to different users

EVENT.SIA_SENT_BACKUP: Event sent to the backup receiver
EVENT.DENIED_FACTORS_MISMATCH: Denied: code and tag of different users
